description: Get the ERC-20 or SPL token balance for a wallet on a specific chain. Returns the raw balance and human-readable balance. Use get_chains to find stablecoin addresses for each chain.

decimals.description: Token decimals. Taken from the response or the token contract when omitted

token.description: Token address (0x-prefixed ERC-20 contract for EVM, Base58 mint for Solana)

name: get_token_balance
